# Catando

> Catando is a free, cozy cat & dog logic puzzle game for iOS (iOS 17 or later), made by Kairos.ai. Players fill a grid with cats and dogs so every row and column balances, no three of the same animal sit in a line, and every = / × hint between tiles holds. Every puzzle is solvable by logic alone — no guessing, no timer, no account.

## How to play

1. Equal counts: every row and every column holds the same number of cats and dogs.
2. Never three alike: no animal appears three times in a row, across or down.
3. Follow the hints: `=` between two tiles means they match; `×` means they differ.

Catando is in the same family of binary grid logic puzzles as Takuzu (Binairo / Binero) and LinkedIn's Tango.

## Modes and features

- Daily Puzzle: one hand-crafted grid per day, the same for every player. Solving keeps a streak alive; one grace day is banked before a streak resets.
- Stage Mode: an endless climb across growing boards from 4×4 to 10×10, unlocked by clearing puzzles and earning Energy.
- Practice Mode: pick any board size (4×4, 6×6, 8×8, 10×10), untimed, with hints and undo.
- Progress Dashboard: login streak with a 7-day paw row, 14-day activity chart, best times per board size.
- 10 badges: First Solve, 3-Day Streak, 7-Day Streak, 30-Day Streak, 7 Dailies in a Row, No Hints Daily, Beat the Par, 8×8 Cleared, 10×10 Cleared, 50 Puzzles Solved.

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS 17 or later
- Price: free to play, ad-supported; optional one-time Remove Ads in-app purchase
- Account: none required (no login, no sign-up)
- Players: single-player
- Language: English
- Developer: Kairos.ai (kairos.ai.tech@gmail.com)
